description: This file defines the NodeGrantDatabaseStorage class, which manages node access grants in Drupal, including database interactions, access checks, caching, and query alterations related to node permissions.

classes.name: NodeGrantDatabaseStorage
classes.description: A class that handles storage and access control for node grants in Drupal, including database operations, access checks, and query modifications.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Checks access permissions for a node based on operation and user account, considering database grants and default permissions.

methods.name: checkAll
methods.description: Returns the total count of node access grants for a user, utilizing caching for efficiency.

methods.name: alterQuery
methods.description: Modifies a database query to include node access control conditions based on grants and language settings.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Stores node access grants in the database for a specific node, handling multiple languages and realms.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes all node access records and clears cache.

methods.name: writeDefault
methods.description: Inserts default node access record with full permissions for all nodes.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of node access records in the database.

methods.name: deleteNodeRecords
methods.description: Deletes node access records for specified node IDs.

methods.name: buildGrantsQueryCondition
methods.description: Creates a database query condition based on an array of node access grants.
